value.title: Background GPS restrictions are checked without starting a recorder
value.statement: Check launch/resume for screen-off GPS Battery Saver policy, user background restriction and battery optimization. Open the applicable public system setting directly when there is one action; retain a choice when multiple restrictions apply, without changing settings or starting a recorder automatically. Retain one acknowledgement per unchanged launch state across rotation; a changed risk warns again and clearing restrictions removes the warning. Legacy Doze prompt suppression does not hide it. Missing Doze exemption means a possible risk, not proof of current GPS failure.
